title: neobartsia adenophylla
intro: Neobartsia adenophylla, commonly known as the "Lis Maco", is a plant species native to Ecuador. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Neobartsia adenophylla include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal activities, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Neobartsia adenophylla and its potential uses in modern medicine.
